Contact our risk team by email or phone and provide the site address, hours of operation, and a brief summary of your concerns. We will schedule a free site visit and deliver a written assessment with recommended solutions. What does a site assessment include? A site assessment includes a perimeter and access review, historical incident analysis, staffing recommendations, required technology, and an estimated cost plan. You receive a prioritized list of mitigations and an implementation timeline. How quickly can you deploy guards? Deployment time depends on contract requirements and location. For urgent needs we can deploy emergency teams within 24 hours in most urban areas. Standard onboarding typically takes 7 to 14 days to complete vetting and training. Are your officers licensed and vetted? Yes. All officers are background screened, licensed where required by local law, and trained in site specific procedures, first aid, and de escalation. Training records are available on request.
